```{r}

#Model log with best
aphelenchus_binomial <- glm(incidence ~ altitute + tillage_corrigido + cropping_corrigido + soil_corrigido + sand + clay + ph, data = aphelenchus_log,family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary(aphelenchus_binomial)

pred_aphelenchus <- predict(aphelenchus_binomial, aphelenchus_log, type = "response")


#Better thresholds
dat_aphelenchus <- data.frame(1, aphelenchus_log$incidence, pred_aphelenchus)
  optimal.thresholds(dat_aphelenchus)

# Confusion matrix with the MAXsen+spe threshold
confusionMatrix(data = as.factor(as.numeric(pred_aphelenchus > 0.82)),  mode= "everything",  reference = as.factor(aphelenchus_log$incidence))


#Plot
auc.roc.plot(dat_aphelenchus)
calibration.plot(dat_aphelenchus)

error.threshold.plot(dat_aphelenchus, opt.methods = 3) #takes a single model and plots the sensitivity and specificity as a function of threshold. 
pcc(cmx(dat_aphelenchus), st.dev = TRUE) #calculates the percent correctly classified and (optionally) the associated standard deviation from a confusion matrix.

presence.absence.accuracy(dat_aphelenchus,threshold=0.82,st.dev=FALSE) #Calculates five accuracy measures (pcc, sensitivity, specificity, Kappa, and AUC)
presence.absence.summary(dat_aphelenchus) #Produces four types of Presence/Absence accuracy plots for a single set of model Predictions

roc_aphelenchus <- roc.plot.calculate(dat_aphelenchus) #data frame

roc_aphelenchus |> 
  ggplot(aes(threshold, sensitivity))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_line(aes(threshold, specificity))+
  geom_line(aes(threshold, Kappa))


#LOOCV
acc_aphelenchus <- NULL
for(i in 1:nrow(aphelenchus_log))
{
    # Train-test splitting
    # 499 samples -> fitting
    # 1 sample -> testing
    train <- aphelenchus_log[-i,]
    test <- aphelenchus_log[i,]
    
    # Fitting
    model <- glm(incidence ~ altitute + tillage_corrigido + cropping_corrigido + soil_corrigido + sand + clay + ph, data = aphelenchus_log,
                family = binomial(link = "logit"))
    
    # Predict results
    results_prob <- predict(model,test,type='response')
    
    # If prob > 0.5 then 1, else 0
    results <- ifelse(results_prob > 0.82,1,0)
    
    # Actual answers
    answers <- test$incidence
    
    # Calculate accuracy
    misClasificError <- mean(answers != results)
    
    # Collecting results
    acc_aphelenchus[i] <- 1-misClasificError
}

# Average accuracy of the model
mean(acc_aphelenchus)


```
